title: Long-trip comfort and travel usability
summary: The examples center mainly on long-trip comfort and usability, with positive comments about seats and ride comfort but also a few concerns about charging confidence or slow access functions, while many fragments are too varied or ambiguously labeled to support a tighter conclusion.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise seat comfort, ride comfort, and reduced fatigue during long trips.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention anxiety about taking long trips in the EV because of charging and frustration with a door opener that takes too long to respond.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mix several loosely related ideas, including vehicle length, long-trip fatigue, seat support, perceived safety, charger availability, and luxury impressions, so the examples are insufficient to resolve a single clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment read for the topic.
The cluster mixes related but not fully consistent subjects, including long-trip comfort, charging on trips, vehicle length, and a slow door opener.
The sampled examples are stratified and not representative of the full population of reviews.
